title: Boltpack bundle.json v1
description: The signed metadata at the root of a .boltpack (a gzip tar of bundle.json, signature.bin and manifests/). Matches what Bolt's pack verifier reads as of 2026-10-20. signature.bin is a 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the exact bytes of this file, so authors never hand-edit it after signing: a pack tool writes it. Fields marked 'planned' are not read by a released Bolt yet.

schema_version.description: BUNDLE_SCHEMA_VERSION. Any other value is refused.

bundle_version.description: The pack's own version, semver by convention (1.2.0). Not compared by the installer today.

signed_by.description: Author email or name as written by the signer. Not proof of identity.

signed_at.description: RFC 3339. Must fall inside the key's validity window for an allowlisted key.

min_bolt_api_version.description: Checked on the admin org-bundle import path only; the personal install path does not check it today.

content_sha256.description: sha256 over every file under manifests/, sorted by path, each fed as u32-LE path length, path bytes, u64-LE content length, content bytes. No file metadata.

bundle_kind.description: util_pack for a personal Boltpack. Absent (or manifest_bundle) is an admin org bundle, which only an allowlisted key may sign.

risk.description: Advisory. Bolt recomputes risk from the entries' declared capabilities and uses its own result.

signer_pubkey.description: Ed25519 public key for a self-signed pack. Proves the files were not changed after signing, not who signed them.

listing.description: Planned: the Bolt Apps gallery listing, the same object as bolt-app.json.

path.description: Path inside the tar. No '..' components.

kind.description: Assigned by folder. Personal packs: utilities/*.yaml = user_utility, scripts/* = script, skills/*.json = skill, agents/*.json = agent; snippets/*.json = snippet and search_engines/*.json = search_engine are planned. Org bundles: builtin/<id>/manifest.yaml = utility, catalog/*.yaml = catalog_pack, and the three config files. Anything else is other and is ignored by every installer.

timeout_ms.description: Declared but not read by the installer today.

capabilities.description: What a script entry declares it touches. Shown on the install review and used for the risk level. NOT enforced at run time today.
